record.question: A mother on day 4 postpartum reports frequent crying, irritability, and mood swings but denies suicidal thoughts. The most likely condition is:
record.explanation: Answer C: Postpartum blues. Postpartum blues commonly begin in the first days after birth and include tearfulness, irritability, and mood swings without severe impairment or suicidality. Source/context note: Persistent symptoms, suicidality, or psychosis require urgent evaluation. Reference: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/postpartum-depression.
